name: AlertDialog
intent: Overlay that stops the user until they cancel or confirm.
usage: Use AlertDialog when the user must choose before going on, like leaving with unsaved changes or deleting something. Use Alert for a message on the page. Escape cancels. Clicking the backdrop does nothing. See contracts/alertdialog.json for the full contract. A portaled panel takes the theme of whatever opened it, so it is dark with a dark app frame even though it is drawn at the end of the page.

open.note: Controlled. The screen owns the open state.

title.note: A short question, like Delete project?

description.note: One or two sentences on what happens next.

actionLabel.note: A verb that names the result, like Delete or Continue. Not Yes or OK.

actionVariant.note: danger for actions that cannot be undone.

useWhen: Confirming an action that cannot be undone.
A decision the user must answer before the page goes on.
doNot: Do not invent a local confirm dialog or use window.confirm.
Do not put forms, tables or extra actions inside.
Do not add a close X or close on backdrop click.
Do not wrap the two Buttons in a ButtonGroup. They stay separate with a gap.
Do not use more than one primary or danger action. The action Button is the one.
a11y: The title names the dialog; the description is aria-describedby.
Focus moves to Cancel on open and returns to the trigger on close.
Tab stays inside the dialog while it is open.
Escape cancels. Backdrop click does nothing.
snippet:
<AlertDialog
  open={open}
  title="Delete project?"
  description="This cannot be undone."
  actionLabel="Delete"
  actionVariant="danger"
  onCancel={close}
  onAction={remove}
/>

examples.title: Confirm
examples.usage: Use primary for a choice that is not destructive. The user still has to pick Cancel or Continue.

props.title: Leave this page?
props.description: You have unsaved changes. Continue without saving?

examples.title: Destructive
examples.usage: Use danger for actions that cannot be undone. Cancel stays secondary. The backdrop does not close it.

props.title: Delete project?
props.description: This cannot be undone. All invoices in this project will be removed.

examples.title: Small
examples.usage: Use sm for short questions with a one-line description.

props.title: Sign out?
props.description: You will need to sign in again.
